subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3: Renewable Energy – Listening and Speaking
outcomes: Predict and listen for details about the Mir'aah solar project.
Talk about the advantages and disadvantages of solar power.
Stress words like 'present' correctly as nouns and verbs.

tf.s: The project in the presentation is called Mir'aah.
tf.why: Yes, Mir'aah is the Omani solar project.

tf.s: In the Mir'aah project, mirrors focus the sun's energy.
A presentation slide is a page that shows key information.
tf.why: Right, slides help the audience follow.

tf.s: 'It is expensive to build' is an advantage of solar power.
Advantages are the good points of something.
tf.why: Well done, disadvantages are the bad points.

tf.s: The noun 'PRESent' has the stress on the second syllable.
tf.why: Nouns like 'PRESent' are stressed on the first syllable.

tf.s: The verb 'preSENT' has the stress on the second syllable.
tf.why: Yes, verbs are stressed on the second syllable.

tf.s: Solar power works best at night.
tf.why: Solar panels need daylight to work.

tf.s: Raya's idea is a solar-powered lunch box.
tf.why: Correct, her invention uses the sun.

tf.s: The Mir'aah project increases the use of natural gas.
tf.why: It reduces the use of natural gas by using solar power.

boxes.q: What is the name of the Omani solar project?
What do mirrors do in the project?

boxes.why: Not working at night is a bad point.

boxes.q: Complete: The main ___ is that it is renewable.
boxes.why: Being renewable is a good point.

boxes.q: Where is the stress in the noun 'RECord'?
Where is the stress in the verb 'inCREASE'?
Good points of an idea are…
What type of competition did the flyer advertise?
Raya's invention is a ___ lunch box.
boxes.why: Raya's lunch box uses the sun.

mcq.q: What do mirrors do in a solar power project like Mir'aah?
mcq.why: Mirrors concentrate sunlight to make energy.

mcq.q: Which phrase do we use to give a disadvantage?
mcq.why: This phrase introduces a bad point.

mcq.q: In words used as nouns and verbs, where is the stress in the noun?
mcq.why: Nouns like PRESent and REcord stress the first syllable.

mcq.q: What is a disadvantage of solar power?
Which sentence uses the verb 'record' correctly with stress?
o: I want to reCORD the speech.
I want to REcord the speech.
This is a reCORD of the trip.
mcq.why: As a verb, the stress is on the second syllable.

mcq.q: Classify: 'Solar power is clean and renewable.'
mcq.why: Clean and renewable are good points.

mcq.q: Before listening, you see slides with mirrors and the sun. What do you predict?
o: The presentation is about a solar project.
The presentation is about coal mines.
The presentation is about a library.
mcq.why: The pictures help us predict the topic.

mcq.q: Why is the Mir'aah project important for Oman?
o: It produces renewable energy and reduces the use of natural gas.
mcq.why: It saves gas by using the sun.

mcq.q: Oman needs more electricity. Which answer gives a balanced evaluation of solar power?
o: The main benefit is that Oman is sunny. The biggest disadvantage is the cost.
Solar power is perfect and has no problems.
Solar power is bad because the sun is renewable.
Oman has no sun, so it is useless.
mcq.why: A good evaluation gives an advantage and a disadvantage.

mcq.q: Why is it important to notice opinions in a listening text?
o: To understand the speaker's position and tell opinion from fact.
To find the date of the recording.
mcq.why: Opinions show what the speaker thinks.
